sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，把DJ台变成一个流动的、充满美感的50年前老物件的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, as John Bolton prepares to become President Trump's new national security advisor,
sentences.zh: 今天，正当约翰·博尔顿准备成为特朗普总统的新任国家安全顾问之际，

sentences.en: a look back at a congressional hearing in 2005 in which damning evidence emerged that Bolton's behavior could be a threat to national security.
sentences.zh: 我们回顾2005年的一场国会听证会，会上出现了确凿证据，表明博尔顿的行为可能会对国家安全构成威胁。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, March 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月28日，星期三。

sentences.en: Now more than ever,
sentences.zh: 如今比以往任何时候都更需要这样做，

sentences.en: the UN must play a critical role as it strives to fulfill the dreams and hopes and aspirations of its original promise to save succeeding generations from the scourge of war,
sentences.zh: 联合国必须发挥关键作用，努力实现其最初承诺的梦想、希望和愿景，即拯救后代免受战祸蹂躏，

sentences.en: to reaffirm faith in fundamental human rights, and to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom.
sentences.zh: 重申对基本人权的信念，并在更大的自由中促进社会进步和更好的生活标准。

sentences.en: Today, I am honored to continue that tradition by announcing that President Bush intends to nominate John Bolton to be our next ambassador to the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 今天，我很荣幸能延续这一传统，宣布布什总统有意提名约翰·博尔顿为我们下一任联合国大使。

sentences.en: And George W.
sentences.zh: 而乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush appoints John Bolton.
sentences.zh: 布什任命了约翰·博尔顿。

sentences.en: The President and I have asked John to do this work because he knows how to get things done.
sentences.zh: 我和总统请约翰来做这项工作，是因为他深知如何把事情办成。

sentences.en: Condoleezza Rice, who was the Secretary of State at the time, praised him as a tough-minded diplomat.
sentences.zh: 时任国务卿康多莉扎·赖斯赞誉他是一位强硬的外交官。

sentences.en: He has a strong record of success, and he has a proven track record of effective multilateralism.
sentences.zh: 他有着辉煌的成功纪录，并且在行之有效的多边主义方面拥有经实践证明的业绩记录。

sentences.en: But John, your most important work is yet to come.
sentences.zh: 但约翰，你最重要的工作还在后头。

sentences.en: And I look forward to working closely with you on behalf of our nation and the international community in support of the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 我期待着代表我国和国际社会与你紧密合作，以支持联合国。

sentences.en: So the next step is that he must receive confirmation by the Senate.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来的步骤是，他必须获得参议院的批准。

sentences.en: Senator Barbara Boxer of California said of Bolton, quote, he's been contemptuous of the U.N.
sentences.zh: 来自加利福尼亚州的参议员芭芭拉·博克泽谈到博尔顿时引述说，他一直对联合国持蔑视态度。

sentences.en: There's a lot to talk about at this hearing.
sentences.zh: 这次听证会有很多内容要谈。

sentences.en: It's going to be very contentious, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，这将是一场非常充满争议的听证会。

sentences.en: This was a controversial nomination from the start.
sentences.zh: 这项提名从一开始就充满争议。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Williamson has been reporting on Bolton's nomination.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·威廉姆森一直在报道博尔顿的提名。

sentences.en: It's clear that John Bolton is clearly is not the right choice for our ambassador.
sentences.zh: 很显然，约翰·博尔顿绝不是我们大使的合适人选。

sentences.en: But letting this man is letting the fox into the hen house.
sentences.zh: 但放任这个人就等于引狼入室。

sentences.en: He already got a reputation for being kind of a bureaucratic headcracker in the State Department.
sentences.zh: 他在国务院已经有了官僚作风强硬的名声。

sentences.en: He's a skillful ninja of a bureaucratic infighter.
sentences.zh: 他是官僚内斗中技术娴熟的忍者。

sentences.en: He's made a career opposing multilateral approaches to international affairs and in total disregard to the opinions of others.
sentences.zh: 他的职业生涯一直在反对处理国际事务的多边方法，并且完全无视他人的意见。

sentences.en: He was known as a hawk among hawks.
sentences.zh: 他被称为“鹰派中的鹰派”。

sentences.en: I mean, he was a conservative's conservative.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是保守派中的保守派。

sentences.en: He had a very bellicose mindset.
sentences.zh: 他有着非常的好战心态。

sentences.en: He was looking for evidence of illicit weapons developments in countries all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他一直在世界各地寻找非法武器研发的证据。

sentences.en: Iran, Iraq, Syria, North Korea.
sentences.zh: 伊朗、伊拉克、叙利亚、朝鲜。

sentences.en: He was very interested in rooting out who was doing what.
sentences.zh: 他非常热衷于查明谁在做什么。

sentences.en: And if necessary, he was advocating for ending those programs by force.
sentences.zh: 如果有必要，他主张用武力终结这些计划。

sentences.en: So you have this guy who is suspicious of diplomacy, of the federal bureaucracy, but yet it turned out that that was the least of his problems once he was in the room.
sentences.zh: 所以你遇到了这样一个人，他对外围外交、联邦官僚机构充满怀疑，但结果证明，一旦他进入那个圈子，这些反而是他最不用担心的问题。

sentences.en: This hearing of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee is called to order.
sentences.zh: 参议院外交关系委员会的这场听证会现在开会。

sentences.en: Given the importance of the position, it is vital that we act both expeditiously and thoroughly in evaluating the nominee.
sentences.zh: 鉴于该职位的重要性，我们在评估被提名人时，务必做到既迅速又彻底。

sentences.en: We look forward to hearing the nominee's insights and learning how he will work on behalf of the president and the secretary of state in fulfilling this duty.
sentences.zh: 我们期待听到被提名人的见解，并了解他将如何代表总统和国务卿履行这一职责。

sentences.en: They set up the meeting for April 11, 2005.
sentences.zh: 他们将会议定在2005年4月11日。

sentences.en: This is the first day.
sentences.zh: 这是第一天。

sentences.en: So Bolton is appearing before them.
sentences.zh: 因此博尔顿出庭接受他们的质询。

sentences.en: He takes his seat in the center of the room.
sentences.zh: 他在房间中央就座。

sentences.en: Arrayed around him is the committee.
sentences.zh: 委员会成员排列在他的周围。

sentences.en: He is so controversial that he is completely prepared to defend himself.
sentences.zh: 他极具争议，以至于做好了充分的自我辩护准备。

sentences.en: But more prepared is the committee itself because they are known for bipartisan cooperation.
sentences.zh: 但委员会本身准备得更充分，因为他们以两党合作而闻名。

sentences.en: They are known for crack investigative work.
sentences.zh: 他们以严厉的调查工作而闻名。

sentences.en: And they have looked deeply into his past, including things that he doesn't even know they know.
sentences.zh: 他们深入调查了他的过去，甚至包括他自己都不知道他们掌握的事情。

sentences.en: I'd like to turn now to the distinguished ranking member of the committee, Senator Biden, for his opening statement.
sentences.zh: 现在我想请委员会资深的排名成员拜登参议员作开场陈述。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: Welcome, Mr. Secretary.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，部长先生。

sentences.en: So they begin, of course, like senators do, with opening statements in which they raise some concerns about him, mostly based on his public record.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们像参议员惯常做的那样，从开场陈述开始，在陈述中他们对他提出了一些担忧，主要基于他的公开记录。

sentences.en: I wonder, as I did in 2001, about your diplomatic temperament.
sentences.zh: 就像我在2001年时一样，我禁不住对你的外交气质产生疑问。

sentences.en: So they talk about his temperament.
sentences.zh: 所以他们谈到了他的气质。

sentences.en: You once quoted the head of the International Law Commission as evidence of the grandiose ambitions of supporters of the International Criminal Court by saying, quote...
sentences.zh: 你曾引用国际法委员会负责人的话，作为国际刑事法院支持者宏伟野心的证据，你说，引述如下……

sentences.en: They talk about his fiery speeches.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了他慷慨激昂的演讲。

sentences.en: That's not some knuckle-dragging Republican from some southern state.
sentences.zh: 那可不是来自南方某个州的智力低下的共和党人。

sentences.en: It's the head of the International Law Commission.
sentences.zh: 那是国际法委员会的主席。

sentences.en: ...about his conservative bomb-throwing.
sentences.zh: ……关于他那保守的四处放炮的作风。

sentences.en: I don't think it's the kind of attitude that is going to serve us very well in the United Nations if it continues.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种态度如果持续下去，对我们在联合国的服务不会有什么太大帮助。

sentences.en: ...about his assertions on chemical and biological weapons prograMs.
sentences.zh: ……关于他针对化学和生物武器计划的断言。

sentences.en: Over the past four years, Iran has accelerated its own nuclear program.
sentences.zh: 在过去的四年里，伊朗加速了自己的核计划。

sentences.en: ...in rogue states like Syria, Iran, Iraq, North Korea.
sentences.zh: ……在叙利亚、伊朗、伊拉克、朝鲜等流氓国家中。

sentences.en: We do know that the approach you apparently advocated has not worked.
sentences.zh: 我们确实知道，你显然主张的方法并没有奏效。

sentences.en: Then they start to talk about his treatment of subordinates.
sentences.zh: 然后他们开始谈论他对待下属的方式。

sentences.en: It has been alleged that he attempted to alter the professional conclusions of an intelligence analyst with whom he disagreed,
sentences.zh: 据指控，他曾试图篡改一位与其意见相左的情报分析师的专业结论，

sentences.en: and that he subsequently sought to disadvantage the analyst's career.
sentences.zh: 并且他随后还试图打击这位分析师的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Now, the staff has, in fact, interviewed Mr. Westerman.
sentences.zh: 现在，工作人员实际上已经采访了韦斯特曼先生。

sentences.en: Chief among them is a man named Christian Westerman, who is an analyst inside the State Department in its intelligence bureau.
sentences.zh: 其中最主要的是一个名叫克里斯蒂安·韦斯特曼的人，他是国务院情报局的一名分析师。

sentences.en: He was an INR biological warfare analySt.
sentences.zh: 他是一名INR生物战分析师。

sentences.en: And he's preparing some analyses for Mr. Bolton, who wants to make a speech on the illicit weapons capabilities of a host of states, including Cuba.
sentences.zh: 他正在为博尔顿准备一些分析报告，博尔顿希望就包括古巴在内的一系列国家的非法武器能力发表一次演讲。

sentences.en: There has been at least an allegation that pressure was applied.
sentences.zh: 至少已经有人指控存在施压行为。

sentences.en: His findings contradicted some of the things that Bolton wanted to say in this speech.
sentences.zh: 他的调查结果与博尔顿在这场演讲中想要表达的一些观点相矛盾。

sentences.en: And so he circulated that.
sentences.zh: 于是他把这份报告传阅了出去。

sentences.en: Bolton accused him of backstabbing him, called him to his office, and dressed him down, red-faced, purple, shaking his finger, shouting at him.
sentences.zh: 博尔顿指责他背后捅刀子，把他叫到办公室大声训斥，气得满脸通红、面色发紫、手指着他大喊大叫。

sentences.en: It gets back to his boss, a guy named Carl Ford.
sentences.zh: 这事传到了他的老板卡尔·福尔德那里。

sentences.en: I remember going back to my office, I came away with the impression that I'd just been asked to fire somebody in the intelligence community for doing what I consider their job.
sentences.zh: 我记得回到办公室时，给我的印象是，我刚刚被要求解雇情报界的一个人，只因为他做了我认为是他们本职工作的事。

sentences.en: First, he confronts Bolton, who says that he wants this guy reassigned.
sentences.zh: 首先，他与博尔顿对质，博尔顿说他想把这个人调走。

sentences.en: But the two of them have such a disagreement that Ford, thinking Bolton outranks me too, and he's asking for this guy's firing, I'm probably next.
sentences.zh: 但两人的意见分歧如此之大，以至于福尔德心想，博尔顿的级别比我高，而且他要求开除这个人，下一个可能就轮到我了。

sentences.en: I'm brave but not stupid.
sentences.zh: 我很勇敢但并不愚蠢。

sentences.en: So, having barked very loudly at an undersecretary of state, I walked up and talked to the secretary.
sentences.zh: 所以，在对国务院副部长大声回顶之后，我走上去和国务卿谈了谈。

sentences.en: Secretary Powell.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔国务卿。

sentences.en: So he goes to Colin Powell, who was the secretary of state at the time, and says...
sentences.zh: 于是他去找了时任国务卿科林·鲍威尔，并说道……

sentences.en: I'd had this confrontation with the undersecretary, and that he might be coming to see him because I'd barked back.
sentences.zh: 我曾与副部长发生过这次冲突，他可能会来找他，因为我顶撞回去了。

sentences.en: And he calls Bolton an 800-pound gorilla.
sentences.zh: 他把博尔顿称为八百磅的大猩猩。

sentences.en: Devouring a banana.
sentences.zh: 正在大嚼香蕉。

sentences.en: The analyst was required simply to stand there and take it.
sentences.zh: 这位分析师被迫只能站在那里逆来顺受。

sentences.en: Meaning he chewed this guy up and spit him out.
sentences.zh: 意思是这个人被他狠狠折磨并被一脚踢开了。

sentences.en: And he said this is so demoralized, this Bureau of Intelligence, whose job it is to find the intelligence that underpins U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说情报局的士气因此大受打击，这个局的职责是寻找支撑美国政策的情报，因此他认为你必须采取行动。

sentences.en: policy, that he says you've got to do something.
sentences.zh: 国务卿特意来到INR的一群聚集人员面前，点名指出了这位分析师。

sentences.en: The secretary made a special point of coming down to an assembled group of people at INR and pointing out the analyst by name.
sentences.zh: 所以，鲍威尔实际上与该局开会，试图鼓励他们：仅仅因为这种事落在了你们自己人头上，

sentences.en: So, Paul actually had a meeting with that bureau to try and encourage them that just because this happened to one of your own,
sentences.zh: 并不意味着你们就不应该继续仗义执言、向权势说真话。

sentences.en: that doesn't mean that you shouldn't continue to speak truth to power.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该受到这一事件的影响。

sentences.en: And that we should not be impacted by this episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，博尔顿仅仅因为一份演讲的事实核查，就想要调走这个职位比他低得多分析师。

sentences.en: So, Bolton wanted to reassign this much junior-than-he analyst over basically fact-checking a speech that Bolton wanted to make.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 然后在那头一天爆出消息，韦斯特曼并不是唯一一个成为目标的人，不仅是被博尔顿整体针对，而且还是因为同一篇演讲而受害，

sentences.en: And then it emerges on that first day that Westerman is not the only one who is targeted, not only by Bolton in general, but over this same speech,
sentences.zh: 在这篇演讲中，他想说古巴在发展生物武器计划方面已经取得了相当大的进展。

sentences.en: where he wanted to say that Cuba was pretty far along in developing a biological weapons program.
sentences.zh: 我们还了解到，他出于类似的原因对中情局的一名情报分析师做了类似的事情。

sentences.en: We also learned that he did something similar to an intelligence analyst at the CIA for similar reasons.
sentences.zh: 他也试图把这个人调走。

sentences.en: He tried to get him reassigned, too.
sentences.zh: 这家伙负责拉丁美洲事务，他的调查结果与博尔顿想要公开宣称的内容不符。

sentences.en: This guy was in charge of Latin America, and his findings didn't agree with what Bolton wanted to say in public.
sentences.zh: 所以，他也对这个人下手了。

sentences.en: So, he went after him as well.
sentences.zh: 整个情报界都广为人知，博尔顿想要这些人的脑袋。

sentences.en: It is widely known throughout the intelligence community that Mr. Bolton wanted these gentlemen's heads.
sentences.zh: 如果我们认为这些事件没有对其他分析师产生寒蝉效应，那我们就是在自欺欺人。

sentences.en: We are kidding ourselves if we don't think that these incidents has had a chilling effect on other analysts.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，在头几天的这些听证会上浮现出的故事是，博尔顿对下属是个恶霸。

sentences.en: So, basically, the story that emerges in these hearings in the first couple of days is that Bolton is a bully towards subordinates.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 慢慢浮出水面的是他为什么要这么做的原因。

sentences.en: What slowly emerges is the why of why he was doing this.
sentences.zh: 他这么做是因为他试图炮制他自己的情报，这些情报某种程度上是基于他自己的假设，而不是基于这些职业专业人员所发掘的事实。

sentences.en: He was doing this because he was trying to create intelligence of his own that was sort of based on his own assumptions rather than on the facts that these career professionals were uncovering.
sentences.zh: 我相信这可能是我们今年就美国安全利益所投的最重要的一票。

sentences.en: I believe this may be the most significant vote any of us cast this year in terms of America's security intereSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为他竟然不知道如何清晰梳理情报的流程，这简直令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: The idea that he doesn't know the process of how to clear intelligence, I find mind-boggling.
sentences.zh: 拜托。

sentences.en: Come on.
sentences.zh: 各位女士先生，这可是件大事。

sentences.en: This is a big deal, guys and ladies.
sentences.zh: 这正是那个可能不得不根据情报向世界阐述朝鲜和伊朗问题的人。

sentences.en: This is the very man who may have to take the case to the world on Korea and on Iran based upon intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我认为这项任命对我们的国家利益是有害的。

sentences.en: I believe this appointment is damaging to our national intereSt.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一个有点天真的问题，但为什么要歪曲情报？

sentences.en: Maybe this is a bit of a naive question, but why misrepresent intelligence?
sentences.zh: 为什么要试图夸大已知和可知的事情，去说那些无法言说也无法知晓的话？

sentences.en: Why try to stretch what's known and knowable to say something that can't be said and can't be known?
sentences.zh: 我想博尔顿的支持者会说他这样做是为了保护国家安全。

sentences.en: I think Mr. Bolton's supporters would say that he was doing that because he was trying to keep the country safe.
sentences.zh: 他的信念是伊拉克、朝鲜、叙利亚，这些国家都是威胁。

sentences.en: His belief is that Iraq, North Korea, Syria, these countries are threats.
sentences.zh: 这些国家对美国人、对美国利益、对我们的国家安全构成了威胁。

sentences.en: These countries are threats to Americans, to American interests, to our national security.
sentences.zh: 所以对他来说，在某种程度上，你知道这些国家就是威胁。

sentences.en: So to him, in a way, you know these countries are threats.
sentences.zh: 既然我们现在就能阻止他们，又何必去抠字眼、一丝不苟或是纠缠细节呢？

sentences.en: So why dot T's or cross I's or sweat the details when we could stop them now?
sentences.zh: 这难道不正是伊拉克战争的某种写照吗？而这场战争正是在参议院确认听证会展开的同时发生的。

sentences.en: Isn't that actually kind of the story of the Iraq war, which is happening as this Senate confirmation hearing is unfolding?
